clips.title: The story
paras: Along Tirisfal's road, Shelene Rhobart trains leatherworkers at a Deathguard waystation. She supplies cured hides and leathercraft training for the Forsaken's military and logistical efforts across the blighted lands.

At a Deathguard waystation southeast of Brill, Shelene Rhobart works along the main road toward the ruins of Lordaeron. Practical crafts still matter in undeath, for survival and war. She turns pelts from Tirisfal's prowling beasts into tough hides, armor, straps, and field gear for Forsaken patrols facing the Scourge and Scarlet crusaders.
